facebook.content:
“**Matthew 6:33** – ‘But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.’  

The Kingdom isn’t a future hope; it’s a present authority that orders every decision, career, and relationship. When we align our priorities with His reign today, provision follows as a natural consequence of His rule.  

What kingdom‑first priority are you choosing to pursue this week?​

instagram.content:
“**The kingdom of God is not food nor drink, but righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.**” — Rom 14:17  

The world offers temporary comforts, but the Kingdom demands a life anchored in divine righteousness, a peace that steadies the storm, and a joy that outlasts circumstance.  

What righteousness are you choosing to claim today?
